summary: Smile is a light Michael Schacht card game where players place fireflies one at a time onto shared critter cards, trying to attract cute creatures while avoiding the wild ones that score negative. It plays fast and is pitched as a family filler built on a simple push-your-luck bidding rhythm.
praised: quick, colorful, easy to teach to families
cute art and a satisfying simple bidding puzzle
criticised: thin for experienced gamers who want more decision depth
can feel repetitive across a full session
luck of card order can swing outcomes

interaction.detail: All fireflies are drawn from and returned to the same shared supply, so every token you commit to a card is one your opponents can't use, and you're watching their pace to time your own bids. There's no private tableau of note beyond the cards you've claimed.

scoring.how_you_win: Spend fireflies wisely across successive auctions to collect the most valuable creature cards while avoiding negative wild critters; highest total once all cards are claimed wins.
